title: Build the List
goal: Return the list 10, 20, 30 with 40 pushed on the end.
hints: push changes the vec, and change needs permission.
with_capacity reserves space but the vec starts empty.
explanation: Two fixes: `push` mutates, so the binding needs `let mut` (E0596 without it), and `[10, 20, 30]` is a fixed-size array, not a Vec - it has no `push` and the wrong return type. `vec![10, 20, 30]` is the list you meant. `Vec::with_capacity(3)` compiles and pushes fine, but starts empty: the test sees [40] and fails. Capacity is a promise about memory, not contents.
